Our Story

Crafted in Nagpur. Trusted Everywhere.

"The best water is water at its most essential — clean, balanced, alive."

Whater was born from a simple belief: everyone deserves access to water that is genuinely clean. Not just treated — but meticulously filtered, tested, and sealed with care.

Manufactured at Plot No. 3A, Gausiya Society, Ring Road, Nagpur — every bottle passes through multi-stage purification before reaching your hands.

No shortcuts. No artificial minerals. No gimmicks. Just water at its purest.



See Our Process →
Why Choose Whater

Built on
Four Pillars.

Quality, safety, sustainability, and transparency — no exceptions.

01
Multi-Stage Filtration

Advanced reverse osmosis with UV treatment eliminates impurities at molecular level while preserving essential minerals.

02
Tamper-Evident Seal

Food-grade PET with tamper-evident cap. Intact seal means guaranteed purity — no questions asked.

03
FSSAI Certified

Full compliance with India's Food Safety and Standards Authority. Every batch tested and certified before dispatch.

04
Eco-First Packaging

100% recyclable bottles. Reduced virgin plastic. Net-zero packaging target by 2027.

💧

Pure at the Source

Every drop begins with a verified, licensed water source. Full traceability from origin to bottle — logged, monitored, documented.

02
🔬

Filtered at Molecular Level

Reverse osmosis membranes with 0.0001 micron precision eliminate dissolved solids, heavy metals, and bacteria — nothing harmful passes through.

03
☀

Sterilised with UV Light

UV-C sterilisation at 254nm wavelength neutralises 99.99% of biological contaminants. No chemicals. No residue. Just pure water.

04
🔒

Sealed with Precision

Tamper-evident food-grade PET. Batch-coded. FSSAI certified. Every bottle traceable from production line to your hands.

How We Do It

From Source
to Sealed.

1
Source Water

Verified, licensed source. Fully logged for traceability.

2
Pre-Filtration

Sediment & carbon filters remove particulates and chlorine.

3
RO Purification

Reverse osmosis eliminates dissolved solids at molecular level.

4
UV Sterilisation

UV-C light neutralises all residual biological contaminants.

5
Seal & Ship

Filled, tamper-sealed, batch-coded and dispatched fresh.
